item.title: Greg Abel Promises to Uphold Berkshire’s Culture in First Letter
item.description: Greg Abel used his inaugural letter as chief executive officer of Berkshire Hathaway to reassure investors that the company would continue to operate with its long-held principles espoused by Warren Buffett.

item.title: Khamenei Killed as US and Israel Strike Iran in Widening War
item.description: Iran’s supreme leader was killed in US-Israeli airstrikes, raising the stakes in a conflict that’s spiraling across the oil-rich Middle East and disrupting traffic around the Hormuz shipping strait.

item.title: India Warns of Hotter-Than-Usual Months as Health Risks Seen
item.description: India is forecast to see above-normal temperatures in the coming months, potentially boosting power demand and posing a severe health risk to residents.

item.description: Calgary, Alberta, Feb. 28, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) — Direct Energy Regulated Services has announced default natural gas rates for March 2026. item.title: Ships Avoid Hormuz as Iran Media Says It’s Practically Shut
item.description: Oil shipping has largely paused in the Strait of Hormuz that links the oil-rich Persian Gulf to the open seas after the US and Israel bombed Iran, with Iranian media saying the waterway is “practically closed.”

item.title: Egypt Seeks Earlier LNG Imports as Israel Cuts Gas Amid Iran War
item.description: Egypt is seeking to bring forward imports of some liquefied natural gas cargoes after energy supplier Israel shuttered some fields following its strikes on Iran, according to people familiar with the matter.

item.title: US Job Growth Seen Moderating After Robust January
item.description: US payrolls growth probably settled back in February after the strongest month of hiring in a year, returning to a more moderate and likely sustainable pace of hiring.

item.title: World Leaders Urge Swift End to Iran Crisis After Khamenei Death
item.description: Global leaders called for a quick resolution to the crisis in the Middle East as US allies backed the decision to target Iran’s supreme leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei.

item.title: Iran Crisis Threatens Worst Disruption in Gas Markets Since 2022
item.description: A widening Middle East conflict looks set to create the most significant disruption for gas markets since Russia’s invasion of Ukraine upended global trade four years ago.

item.title: Iran’s Supreme Leader Killed in US-Israeli Attacks as War Widens
item.description: Iran’s supreme leader was killed in US–Israeli airstrikes, a seismic development in a conflict that’s spread to half a dozen countries across the Middle East and threatens to disrupt energy flows.
